# Every OID here is worked out by hand from the arcs the source writes:
# iso(1) org(3) dod(6) internet(1) private(4) enterprises(1) is 1.3.6.1.4.1,
# and 47000 is this module's own arc under it.
#
# The base types and their spellings are RFC 2578 section 7.1; the access
# values are section 7.3 and the status values section 7.4.

dialect  TEST-SCALARS-MIB SMIv2
identity TEST-SCALARS-MIB testScalars

oid  TEST-SCALARS-MIB.testScalars 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000
kind TEST-SCALARS-MIB.testScalars node
oid  TEST-SCALARS-MIB.scalars 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1
kind TEST-SCALARS-MIB.scalars node

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.6: Counter32 is a non-negative integer that wraps.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.1
kind        TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount scalar
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount Counter32
access      TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount read-only
status      TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount current
units       TEST-SCALARS-MIB.packetCount packets

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.10: Counter64 is the 64-bit counter, and is a base
# type of its own rather than a Counter32 with a wider range.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.octetCount 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.2
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.octetCount Counter64
units       TEST-SCALARS-MIB.octetCount octets

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.7 for Gauge32, section 11.1 for the range that
# subtypes it: the constraint is the object's, not the base type's.
oid           TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fillLevel 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.3
syntax-base   TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fillLevel Gauge32
syntax-ranges TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fillLevel 0..100
access        TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fillLevel read-write

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.8.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.upTime 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.4
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.upTime TimeTicks

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.1 fixes Integer32 at -2^31 through 2^31-1, which
# is what this object writes out in full.
oid           TEST-SCALARS-MIB.signedValue 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.5
syntax-base   TEST-SCALARS-MIB.signedValue Integer32
syntax-ranges TEST-SCALARS-MIB.signedValue -2147483648..2147483647

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.11 fixes Unsigned32 at 0 through 2^32-1.
oid           TEST-SCALARS-MIB.unsignedValue 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.6
syntax-base   TEST-SCALARS-MIB.unsignedValue Unsigned32
syntax-ranges TEST-SCALARS-MIB.unsignedValue 0..4294967295

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.2: a SIZE constraint bounds the length, so it is
# held apart from a value range.
oid           TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.7
syntax-base   TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label OCTET STRING
syntax-sizes  TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label 0..255
syntax-ranges TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label (none)
access        TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label read-create

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.3.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.pointer 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.8
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.pointer OBJECT IDENTIFIER

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.5.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.address 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.9
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.address IpAddress

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.9.
oid         TEST-SCALARS-MIB.wrapped 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.10
syntax-base TEST-SCALARS-MIB.wrapped Opaque

# RFC 2578 section 7.1.1: an enumerated INTEGER keeps the numbers its
# labels were given, and none of them may be zero.
oid            TEST-SCALARS-MIB.deviceState 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.11
syntax-base    TEST-SCALARS-MIB.deviceState INTEGER
syntax-members TEST-SCALARS-MIB.deviceState up(1) down(2) testing(3)

# RFC 2578 section 7.9 gives DEFVAL one form per kind of value, and each
# of the five below is a different one of them. What the model carries is
# the value, so a quoted string and a hexadecimal literal land in the
# same shape and are asserted the same way: "none" is 6e6f6e65 and
# 'c0a80001'H is the four octets of 192.168.0.1. A descriptor is kept as
# the name it is, because which node or which enumeration label it stands
# for is a lookup rather than part of the clause.
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fillLevel integer 50
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.label octets 6e6f6e65
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.pointer label scalars
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.address octets c0a80001
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.deviceState label up
default TEST-SCALARS-MIB.upTime (none)

# RFC 2578 section 7.4: obsolete and deprecated are both SMIv2 status
# values, and section 7.3 defines accessible-for-notify.
oid    TEST-SCALARS-MIB.retiredValue 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.12
status TEST-SCALARS-MIB.retiredValue obsolete
oid    TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fadingValue 1.3.6.1.4.1.47000.1.13
status TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fadingValue deprecated
access TEST-SCALARS-MIB.fadingValue accessible-for-notify
